# T22 drawing pack references

- India NF 2025-26 Competition Regulations, C2.10.6, printed page 13: the 13 mandatory contents items; A4 engineering drawings and a separate A4 render PDF. Local source SHA-256: 6fdd441b54a1a2fbf48f63019f21728d658386bd902a499d74c710ef279338bf.
- [build123d technical drawing tutorial](https://build123d.readthedocs.io/en/stable/tech_drawing_tutorial.html), retrieved with TinyFish 2026-11-02: orthographic views, section/annotation workflow and SVG export. No tutorial code copied.
- Installed OCP HLRBRep_PolyAlgo API documentation: polygonal hidden-line removal uses triangulated geometry. Selected after exact BRep HLR proved impractically slow on the imported Orbit assembly. Outline tolerance 0.1 mm; numeric extents from CAD, not the tessellation.

A generated pack remains a draft: missing named features, local dimensions and surface-boundary identification are explicitly listed for engineering review.
